The code draws with the theme inks of main (`note_ink`, `dim_ink`, `warn_ink`, `bad_ink`, `tool_ground`). On main's side, these hunks changed only colours. The merge adds no colour literal.
- `crates/ui/tests/theme_files/colour_literals.rs`: the allow-list is main's list, with no change.
- The default theme inks have the same values as the old constants. Thus the tool editor looks the same, and this PR gets no new screenshot.
- `#[test]` count of `crates/ui`: 1971 on the old head, 1976 on `origin/main`, 1983 after the merge.

Reviewer: wopr pool job review-4377-r2, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a `feat` PR. It merges at the next cut.

This is the first review with a marker on this PR. The earlier record of this pool (head `7e2d12ae1`) stopped without a verdict, because the author merged `main` with hand edits. The facts of that record are checked again below on the new head.

## Scope

- The diff is in `crates/ui` and `docs/decisions/` only (27 files).
- The PR does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a SAFETY-tier review.
- The PR does not touch `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, a `Cargo.toml`, `xtask/` or a process file. No new dependency.
- No `tests/golden/`, `*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`, `testdata/` or snapshot PNG changes. No importer code. The extra suites of the importer rule and the test-data rule do not apply.

## Trial merge

- PR head `c4c8060d9` already contains `upstream/main` `c79c9b24f`. `git merge upstream/main` says "Already up to date". The tree that I tested is the PR head.

## Results (local, host wopr, Linux)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 18 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
  - `ui build (--no-run)`: ok.
  - `ui suites: lib`: 1780 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
  - 16 ui integration suites (`boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `catalog_render`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `feedback`, `fixtures`, `gpu_render`, `machine`, `models`, `operations`, `shell`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool`): all ok. The host has a software GPU adapter (llvmpipe). No suite failed on the adapter.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Extra suites run: none apply (no `testdata/`, fixture, golden or importer change).
- Heavy lanes and light lane: not run. The diff is UI only and reaches no heavy lane. No heavy result is a merge condition.

## Mutations (two, both red as expected; the tree was restored after each)

1. `assembly_group::clamp_check`: skip the `fits_shank` refusal. Red: `the_clamp_check_states_the_range_or_the_refusal` and `a_shank_outside_the_clamping_range_is_refused_by_name`.
2. `PreviewMode`: make `Model` the default again. Red: `the_side_drawing_is_the_default_and_a_still_frame_builds_nothing`.

## What looks good

- Tool tab edits stay draft fields. The footer's Apply lands them as one `ChangeTool`, and the number as `SetToolNumber`. The pinning test checks one undo step for each and the undo of each.
- The Name is shown and not typed, because no rename command exists. Follow-up #4370 asks for `RenameTool` with its MCP tool.
- Properties keeps its old rows: `geometry()` calls the new row pieces in the old order, `catalog()` keeps the helix angle and the tool number, and `cutting()` keeps centre cutting through `lathe_and_entry`.
- `clamp_check` names the refusing holder with the library's own reason. It shows no "Fits:" line beside a refusal.
- The flute lines are built with the cached model (`ToolModel::flute_lines`). A still frame builds no model, and a counter test pins this. `side_lines` has a point bound, and the painter drops non-finite points.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` outside tests. `spindle_nose` checks that its coordinates are finite.
- The merge with the theme inks of #1120 adds no colour literal. `theme_files` is green, with main's allow-list.
- The body has before and after screenshots on the `pr-screenshots` branch, a `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #4336` and a decisions file (`docs/decisions/4336-tool-editor.md`). The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes up.
- The new test file has its gate map and its provenance line.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings_grid.rs` goes from 352 to 404 lines. This is at the limit of about 400 lines. A later split of the Catalog rows is possible.
- `tool_tab.rs` draws the group headings and the Name with `ui.label(RichText ...)`, not with a form helper. The form seam is "in progress" (#1122), so this is not a finding.
